x1.reason: A second Ctrl-C landing inside the counter reconciliation query can drop one served reply from the tally. Needs two interrupts within milliseconds during an operator-run eval; the committed passes are unaffected and replay byte-identical.
x1.fix: Shield the reconciliation from KeyboardInterrupt (signal mask or a second-interrupt guard) so the finally block always completes.

x2.reason: A retry can pay for reads before the report refuses an inherited inconsistent pass. Only a pass written by pre-fix code is inconsistent, and none exists in the committed run files.
x2.fix: Validate earlier passes with the same check spent() uses before the retry makes its first paid call.

x3.reason: Two record runs on the same pair at once can overwrite each other's passes. One operator runs one pass per pair; same cause as the earlier deferred concurrent-writer finding.
x3.fix: Hold a per-pair lock file for the length of a record run, or write checkpoints keyed by pass id.

x4.reason: With no MANIFEST.json in the clips folder, a transcript row with a null sha256 matches a missing manifest entry. The gold clips folder always has a manifest; the CLI refuses non-gold output under evals/voice.
x4.fix: Refuse when the manifest is missing or a clip is unlisted, before comparing hashes.
